title: The Vector of the Rust Belt
author: Oscar Ashgrove
blurb: Tamsin Delacroix, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
